subject: skill:anatomy
gist: Adds the habit anatomy, the explanatory figure of a concept
reason: Adds anatomy as a copy, a default habit flagged extra under the asset rule, with its kit and scripts and no worked examples; its gallery publication, session reader, tests, evals and harness file are left out.
